children: On November 23, 2026, Nasdaq notified Hadron Energy that its stock had traded below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance; its stock will continue trading on Nasdaq during this period, with no immediate effect on its listing.
